housing-numbers.notes: 95,000 homes includes 5% buffer, represents 43% increase on previous planning. Housing spatial strategy shows 7 approaches with potential delivery ranges: Brownfield sites (1,500-2,500), Urban extensions (23,000-28,000), New towns (11,000-13,000), Transport hubs (16,000-19,000), Employment areas (5,000-6,000), Village expansion (13,000-15,000), Edge of county (6,000-7,000). Total potential ranges from 75,500-90,500 homes.
